pricing.title: Token pricing
pricing.subtitle: Yotuvia is prepaid with YOTUVIA tokens: 1 unit of currency loads 1 token, and a larger load unlocks a bigger bonus.
pricing.currency_hint: Bonus ladder for this currency. Bonus tokens are added on top of the amount you load.
pricing.note: Yotuvia only settles in YOTUVIA tokens. There is no card gateway or subscription: you transfer the amount, the center confirms the receipt and the tokens are credited to your balance.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything about tokens, data and getting started.
faq.q1: Do I need a credit card to start?
faq.a1: No. Yotuvia has no card gateway: you load YOTUVIA tokens by transfer and the center confirms the receipt to credit your balance.
faq.q2: Can clients book without an account?
faq.a2: They can search and browse centers without signing in. To confirm a booking they sign in, so they can manage their appointments and QR codes.
faq.q3: Does Yotuvia work for barbershops and aesthetic centers too?
faq.a3: Yes. Services, durations and prices are fully configurable, so barbershops, salons and aesthetic centers can model their own catalog.
faq.q4: Can I keep my own domain and branding?
faq.a4: You can share your public center link. Custom domains are not part of the product today; reach out if you need one.
faq.q5: How do I migrate my current data?
faq.a5: Create your center, add your services and staff, and import your client list whenever you are ready. Our team can help you through it.

terms.subtitle: Draft skeleton of the rules for using Yotuvia, pending legal review.

acceptance.title: 1. Acceptance of these terms
acceptance.body:
By creating an account, accessing or using Yotuvia (the "Service") you agree to these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree, do not use the Service.

If you use the Service on behalf of a business, you confirm that you are authorised to bind that business to these terms.

provider.title: 2. Who operates the Service
provider.body: The Service is operated by [PLACEHOLDER: company legal name], registered at [PLACEHOLDER: registered address], contact [PLACEHOLDER: legal contact email]. [PLACEHOLDER: tax or company registration number]. These details must be completed before publication.

service.title: 3. The Service
service.body:
Yotuvia is a management platform for beauty salons, barbershops and aesthetic centers. It lets businesses manage their agenda, clients, services, staff, loyalty and token balance, and lets clients discover beauty centers and request appointments.

During this draft phase the Service is provided as-is and its features may change.

accounts.title: 4. Accounts
accounts.body: You must provide accurate information when you register and keep your credentials secure. You are responsible for activity carried out under your account. You may not impersonate another person or business, and you may not share an account in a way that circumvents the intended access rules.

tokens.title: 5. Tokens and payments
tokens.body:
Yotuvia is prepaid with YOTUVIA tokens. Tokens are loaded by bank transfer and credited once the center confirms the receipt. There is no card gateway and no online checkout in the Service.

Bonus percentages are published on the pricing page and are applied at the moment a top-up is approved. Tokens are a service credit: they are not a currency, do not earn interest and are not redeemable for cash, except where the law requires it.

acceptable_use.title: 6. Acceptable use
acceptable_use.body: You agree not to misuse the Service, including by attempting to access it without authorisation, interfering with its operation, scraping or reselling data, uploading unlawful or harmful content, or using the Service to harass other users.

bookings.title: 7. Appointments and bookings
bookings.body: Appointments are requested by clients and confirmed by the center. A booking is a relationship between the client and the center; Yotuvia provides the tooling and is not a party to the appointment. Cancellation, no-show and deposit rules, where they exist, are set by each center.

content.title: 8. Content
content.body: You keep ownership of the content you upload. You grant Yotuvia a licence to host and display that content as needed to operate the Service. Content that infringes third-party rights or breaks the law may be removed.

availability.title: 9. Availability and changes
availability.body: We aim to keep the Service available but do not guarantee uninterrupted access. We may modify, suspend or discontinue features and may perform maintenance.

liability.title: 10. Limitation of liability

termination.title: 11. Suspension and termination

privacy.subtitle: Draft skeleton of how Yotuvia handles personal data, pending legal review.

controller.title: 1. Who is responsible for your data
controller.body: The data controller is [PLACEHOLDER: company legal name], [PLACEHOLDER: registered address]. Contact: [PLACEHOLDER: privacy contact email]. These details must be completed before publication.

collected.title: 2. Data we collect
collected.body: We collect: account data (name, email, phone, role, password hash); center data (business name, address, schedules, services, staff, gallery and social links); booking data (services, professional, date, time, status and deposit receipts); token data (balance, top-up requests and receipts); usage and device data (log and diagnostic information); and, with your permission, approximate location used to show nearby centers.

usage.title: 3. How we use your data
usage.body: We use the data to provide and secure the Service, manage accounts, process appointments and top-ups, show nearby centers, send service messages, prevent abuse and improve the product.

legal_basis.title: 4. Legal basis
legal_basis.body: Where required, we rely on: performance of a contract (to provide the Service), legitimate interests (security, fraud prevention and product improvement), consent (location and optional communications), and legal obligations (record keeping). [PLACEHOLDER: legal basis to be confirmed for each processing purpose].

sharing.title: 5. Sharing with third parties
sharing.body: We share data with: the center you book with (to fulfil the appointment); infrastructure, email and push providers acting as processors; and authorities where the law requires it. We do not sell personal data. [PLACEHOLDER: list of processors and any international transfers to be completed].

retention.title: 6. How long we keep data
